claim: Handle retains routing tensor by reference and version-checks ordinary in-place mutation; inference-mode/raw-pointer writes are not fully detectable.
Expanded cumulative ends include aligned prior starts plus actual current count; actual range starts require aligning the previous end.
No-CPU-sync allocation reserves capacity rows; meaningful non-expanded total remains in per-scaleup-rank prefix metadata.
Upstream test trims capacity-sized values and source metadata before asserting exact receive row counts.
Direct dispatch deduplicates token delivery by destination rank while preserving per-expert contributions.
Packed TokenLayout aligns values/scales/metadata and always uses internal 32-bit expert metadata independent of public index width.
Cached dispatch reuses destination slots and forbids CPU count synchronization; cached handles must match routing and launch geometry.
Direct logical scaleup may span physical RDMA peers when hybrid is disabled; physical and logical domains remain distinct.
Host communicator acquisition distinguishes cached borrowed PyTorch pointers from managed fresh NCCL communicators.
NCCL Gin context requests GDAKI capability and selected full/rail/custom-stride arrangements under the runtime configuration.
Buffer sizing uses maximum of dispatch and BF16 combine requirements with allocation alignment and separate workspace.
BufferAllocator plans meta tensors at aligned offsets and materializes one exact byte storage once.
Native EP destruction coordinates GPU barrier, pinned host workspace release, context finalization, and LB view reset.
Dispatch launcher selects direct/hybrid specializations and derives notify/dispatch/forward warp roles from configuration.
Hybrid forwarding waits for acquire-published tails or finish flags and retains channel route metadata for reverse traversal.
Hybrid combine replays forwarding route and issues rail return puts after local staging stores complete.
Combine activation reduction is separate from returned top-k weight values; no general activation gate multiply is performed.
Combine helper has limited no-bias BF16-add bypass and float intermediate accumulation for other paths.
Reference combine models local and scaleup grouping separately, including bias-sensitive numerical ordering.
Previous-event producer waits require comm-stream allocation, while asynchronous epilogue records storage on streams or retains tensors in event.
EventOverlap waits on current stream, runs deferred hook once, and context manager waits on exit rather than entry.
Deferred dispatch and combine return EventOverlap directly, whose first wait produces four or two outputs respectively.
DeepJIT configuration tracks DeepEP headers and includes NCCL include path/index/Gin defines in compiler options.
Installation builds host bindings/context/driver sources rather than all GPU specializations.
Weight prefetch mapping is identical within LSA domain, domain-local expert numbering, with redundant destinations in LB storage.
Gradient exchange adds redundant FP32 gradients into seeded destinations and exactness tests intentionally use small integer patterns.
Prefetch tests verify distinct expert/payload patterns and unchanged sentinel bytes for unused redundant slots.
Bucket sessions reject nesting, enforce one context, and stage bounded storage while caller owns prior-use completion.
PP ring adjacency and Engram indexed fetch are separate experimental operation families from EP handles.
Correctness tests compare routing reference identity, valid expanded slots, padding, count metadata, and final activation/weight results.
